skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply knowledge on specialization and intensification in agricultural production.
Understand and apply knowledge on intensification in agricultural production.
Understand and apply knowledge on economic services in agriculture.
Understand and apply knowledge on economic management of agricultural production.
Understand and apply knowledge on government macro management in agriculture.
Ability to solve specific problems in agricultural economics through information gathering and planning.
Develop self-discipline, responsibility, and teamwork skills.
Develop the ability to learn independently and continuously improve professional skills.
